capabilities.name: Installable PL CLI
capabilities.description: Provide an installable and update-compatible pl command-line interface for supported Windows and Linux environments.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Wave 1.4.1 CLI packaging discovery and shell integration
capabilities.notes: The CLI ships with the desktop suite and must cleanly install and uninstall.

capabilities.name: Shell Discovery and Integration
capabilities.description: Support discovery, configuration, completion, help, and environment integration for supported system shells.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Wave 1.4.1 CLI packaging discovery and shell integration
capabilities.notes: Target environments include Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, Command Prompt, and WSL where applicable.

capabilities.name: Project-Aware CLI Context
capabilities.description: Detect PL project roots and expose project metadata, slices, assets, tasks, workflows, providers, and build targets safely.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Wave 1.4.2 Project-aware command model
capabilities.notes: Destructive commands must not guess targets when project context is ambiguous.

capabilities.name: Slice Command Groups
capabilities.description: Expose supported headless operations for Docs, Spreadsheets, Code, Modeler, Animation, and Game Studio.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Wave 1.4.3 Slice engine and job commands
capabilities.notes: Examples include Docs export, Sheets recalc, Code build or test, Modeler validation, Animation render, and Game run or build.

capabilities.name: Engine Command Groups
capabilities.description: Expose safe engine diagnostics, benchmarks, simulation, rendering, cache, validation, and related operations through the CLI.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Wave 1.4.3 Slice engine and job commands
capabilities.notes: Final engine command coverage is defined by the v1.6-v1.8 engine capability program.

capabilities.name: CLI Job Control
capabilities.description: List, inspect, monitor, cancel, retry, and navigate outputs for jobs executed through shared suite task infrastructure.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Wave 1.4.3 Slice engine and job commands

capabilities.name: Workflow CLI
capabilities.description: List, validate, dry-run, execute, monitor, cancel, and inspect workflows from scripts or interactive shell sessions.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Wave 1.4.4 Workflow and automation command surface
capabilities.notes: Local automation must remain useful without requiring cloud infrastructure.

capabilities.name: Human and Structured Output
capabilities.description: Provide stable human-readable and machine-readable JSON output for supported CLI commands.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Required outcomes and Wave 1.4.5
capabilities.notes: Structured output enables workflows, scripts, tests, and external tooling to consume results reliably.

capabilities.name: Stable CLI Exit Codes
capabilities.description: Define stable documented exit codes for success, validation failure, permission denial, unsupported operations, job failures, and other command outcomes.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Required outcomes and Wave 1.4.5

capabilities.name: CLI Trust and Security
capabilities.description: Require explicit trust and confirmation for destructive, shell, network, credential, privilege, and external-file operations.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Wave 1.4.5 Logging security and developer contracts
capabilities.notes: Logs must redact sensitive data and risky commands may not execute silently.

capabilities.name: Extension CLI Registration
capabilities.description: Provide controlled command-registration contracts for first-party plugins and future extensions.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Wave 1.4.5 Logging security and developer contracts
capabilities.notes: Extension commands must declare arguments, permissions, help, and compatibility through stable contracts.

capabilities.name: Offline CLI Operation
capabilities.description: Keep local project inspection, validation, workflows, slice operations, and supported engine commands usable without an account or subscription.
capabilities.source: v1.4 PL Command Bridge — Validation and public-beta release gate
capabilities.notes: Cloud-backed commands may require online services, but the local Command Bridge itself remains offline-first.
